Our methodology is structured to deliver twelve hospital sites safely, consistently, and in full compliance with the Energy Department’s requirements, while maintaining continuity of hospital operations through phased execution and strict site controls under our documented HSE policy and site safety plans (including zero reportable fatalities on record) [CO-PROFILE].

We will execute the works in four controlled phases: (1) mobilization and site surveys, (2) detailed engineering, procurement, and approvals, (3) installation, testing and commissioning, and (4) handover with three-year O&M.

For surveys and engineering, our team will perform site-by-site assessments (roof/ground suitability, electrical tie-in points, load profiles, shading, and protection coordination) and develop IFC drawings and method statements for each hospital; our library evidences multiple completed solar deployments, including provincial and federal government engagements, supporting our ability to execute similar design-to-commission cycles at scale [CAP-008][CAP-020].

For supply and installation, we will procure and submit for approval Tier-1 PV modules (≥21% efficiency, 25-year linear warranty), string inverters, and mounting structures as specified. Our library does not yet evidence Tier-1 module brand lineage or the stated efficiency/warranty parameters; we will address this through pre-award submission of manufacturer Tier-1 listings and warranty certificates in the technical submittals for your approval [CO-PROFILE]. Civil/electrical works will be executed with qualified supervision, leveraging our PE-registered engineers and established infrastructure delivery controls [CO-PROFILE].

For SCADA/remote monitoring and a central dashboard, our library does not yet evidence SCADA deployment on PV; we will integrate an OEM-backed monitoring stack and provide centralized access and reporting aligned to your KPI and performance guarantee regime [CO-PROFILE].

We will lead DISCO liaison for net-metering applications; while our library does not yet evidence net-metering approvals explicitly, we will assign a dedicated approvals focal point and manage end-to-end documentation, inspection coordination, and energization scheduling [CO-PROFILE].

Post-commissioning, we will train hospital engineering staff and provide three-year comprehensive O&M with quarterly preventive maintenance and 24–48 hour response SLAs, aligned to the RFP’s fault-response expectations [CO-PROFILE].
